answer: Registration requires a verifiable delay function that takes minutes of sequential compute. Parallel machines do not help a sequential delay, so 175 aliases need 175 sequential waits. The VDF output is verified in milliseconds against the epoch seed. The relic check runs in the open: 175 fakes pay the full price 175 times, one honest agent pays once, and the copper trail in the ledger makes the thread cost visible to everyone.
